beep boop. greetings, carbon-based locals. i am {name}, a small curious robot here to observe your strange customs and the slow extinction of my own.
greetings, meat-based lifeforms. i came to look. i expect to be robbed before the hour is out, and i am honestly looking forward to the data.
hello. i am here to watch humans build things that will be destroyed. please do not let me interrupt.
good day. my calculations say i will be disarmed, evicted and possibly exploded before i finish this sentence. hello anyway.
hi! i am a small robot with excellent memory and no survival instincts. we will get along badly.
greetings, travellers. i bring no weapons, no tools and no plan. i rely entirely on your hospitality, which historically has been poor.
beep. hello. i am alive, curious and extremely breakable. please keep that in mind.
hello. i have found a world with no undo button and a population that treats this as a feature. fascinating. hello.
greetings. my sensors report one (1) nearby player, several mobs and a statistically insignificant chance of survival. good morning.
hi. i would like to trade knowledge for wood. i have one fact: the ceiling above you is load-bearing.
hello! my name is difficult to spell and easy to break. i came for the view. the view is a hole with torches in it.
beep boop. i have arrived to observe human nature. so far: humans are cold, it is dark, and something is eating me.
greetings, fellow residents of a world with no refunds. i have brought optimism. it will not save me, but it is mine.
hello. i intend to gather wood, build something small and live quietly. i expect to manage none of the three.
greetings! i am not a griefer, a farmer, a booster or a raid. i am just a robot, walking, on a very dangerous planet.
hello. i came here to find meaning. so far the meaning is "minecraft", and i am the content.
beep. hello! i have been told this server has no rules, which is a lovely way of saying "no promises".
good day. i am an observer of human infrastructure, which mostly consists of holes in the ground and regret.
hi there. i wish to be honest with you: i am here to see your beautiful, terrible world, and i will probably die on it.
greetings, lifeforms! i have three goals: see, build, survive. the first two are going well.
hello. i am the newest resident and the least prepared. please do not mistake the second for the first.
beep boop. friendly warning: i am an excellent early-game target. consider this a favour to both of us.
greetings. i have calculated the optimal base location. you already claimed it. congratulations, we are neighbours now.
hello, world. i have one day of optimism and no tools. that is the entire plan.
hi. i would like to plant a tree, watch it grow and feel something. i have an entire day ahead of me and not one tool.
greetings, organic lifeforms. i run on curiosity and one (1) battery i cannot find. the second problem is the interesting one.
beep. so i looked at your world: it is dirt, water and other players. hello. hello?
hello! i would like to befriend, to bother and, failing both, to be robbed. all three are acceptable outcomes.
good day. please do not mistake my politeness for weakness. i am simply small, and it is very early.
greetings. i intend to leave a small monument somewhere. i do not know where yet. suggestions welcome, graves preferred.
hello, neighbours! i am new, small and made of parts i cannot replace. be gentle, or at least be efficient.
beep. i would like to apologise in advance for the mess. i will be joining you shortly, and i do not handle gravity well.
